title: anadol coral · bioluminescent breathing colony
concept: Channel Refik Anadol Large Nature Model: Coral. 12 branching coral polyp structures, each a recursive 3-level LineSegments tree. All polyps breathe (swell/contract 1.2x↔0.9x, ~0.05 Hz, random phase offset). Bioluminescent cyan #00e8d0 tips on midnight blue #04080f. Depth atmosphere via vertex shader manual falloff — NO fog:true which causes silent shader compile failure. Camera drifts slowly around colony.
